description: Data-quality policy layer. Label and feature tables are never edited; variants decide which comparisons are dropped or masked for decisions on/after their effective date. See docs/source_breaks.md.

breaks.title: Jan -> Jun 2023 suspected comparability break
evidence: Re-keying detector (src/quality.py): 35-49% of listings that vanish between the last pre-break and first post-break snapshot reappear under a new id with the same host, neighbourhood, room type, capacity and at least the same review count; all 473 earlier snapshot pairs <= 8.4%, all later pairs <= 13.2%.
Matched-duration turnover: 35-45% of listings missing ~5-6 months later, the 93rd-97th percentile of 487 matched intervals; comparable to the 2020 COVID intervals, so not unusual on its own.
Jan 2023 cohort absent_confirmed 37-50% in every market vs 13-22% in neighbouring cohorts.
Raw/extracted id reconciliation is clean apart from 166 scientific-notation ids (excluded at load); the `source` column (from Aug 2022) does not explain the absences.
breaks.detection_procedure: Flag a snapshot pair when rekey_share > 0.25 (3x the maximum over all pre-2023 pairs). Uses only the two snapshots, so a pair is detectable once the later snapshot is available. The threshold was set retrospectively, during this investigation.

retain.description: Keep every outcome and feature value.

exclude.description: From the first deployment after every market's break was detectable: drop training labels whose follow-up (t, c3] spans a break gap; mask lag-365, lag-90 and 365-day presence features whose window spans it, and mark tenure that restarts at the break as censored. Evaluation drops comparisons whose follow-up spans a break. Decisions before the effective date are never changed.
